answer: Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A ripple of per-task receipts records who did what, and the shale of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
